mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 48 degrees out by the Verona Area High School with the Waxing Gibbous moon shining bright. Tonight will reach a low of 45 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

The Public Works Department is reminding all residents to properly dispose of fats, oils, and greases to prevent costly sewer clogs and local waterway pollution. Please remember to scrape your pans into the trash rather than pouring them down the drain.

We have a busy schedule ahead in Verona. Today, you can enjoy Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher event at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, make sure to check out the ART House 360 events or test your skills at Hop Haus Trivia.

In our weekly report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman unresponsive in her vehicle. After assistance from the fire department, she was arrested for O W I.

Our team at Culver's has finished serving up the OREO Cookie Cheesecake for the day. We are currently closed for the night, but we will be back at it tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM with our delicious Double Strawberry flavor.
